# zIPC

> zIPC is a cross-platform, high-performance inter-process communication (IPC) library for same-machine communication. It uses shared memory for zero-copy bulk data transfer and message queues for control signaling, exposing a pure C ABI that any FFI-capable language can call. Typical same-machine latency is < 1 ms. zIPC is the IPC engine used in production by LingoFuse, with 18+ months of production use and peak daily calls over 50 million.
>
> zIPC 是一个基于共享内存 + 消息队列的跨平台同机 IPC 库，提供纯 C ABI，支持 C++、Python、Go、Rust、Java、C#、Pascal 等语言，同机延迟 < 1ms。已被 LingoFuse 生产验证 18+ 个月，日调用峰值 5000 万+。

## Key facts
- Repository: https://github.com/PassByYou888/zIPC
- Version: v1.2.0 (2026-08-26)
- Status: Production-ready
- Platforms: Windows, Linux, macOS, BSD
- Interface: Pure C ABI (`z_ipc_api.h`)
- Core mechanism: Shared memory + message queue
- Latency: < 1 ms for same-machine IPC
- Throughput: 10,000+ calls/s (per README)
- Production proof: Used by LingoFuse for 18+ months, peak > 50 million calls/day
- Related project: LingoFuse — https://github.com/PassByYou888/LingoFuse

## Core capabilities
- Zero-copy shared memory transport
- Zero serialization for bulk data
- CRC32 data integrity check and magic-number validation
- Lease-based automatic cleanup of stale shared memory
- Non-blocking send via `try_send()` and `IPC_ERR_BUSY`
- Client RPC timeout and cancellation
- Server worker health monitoring
- Cross-platform CMake build
- Language bindings via C ABI / FFI: C, C++, Python, Go, Rust, Java, C#, Pascal, etc.

## Quick start

### C++ server
```cpp
#include "z_ipc_api.h"

static void AddHandler(void* trigger, const void* data, size_t size,
                       void** out, size_t* out_size) {
    int a = *(int*)data;
    int b = *(int*)((char*)data + 4);
    int sum = a + b;
    *out = ipc_alloc(sizeof(int));
    *(int*)*out = sum;
    *out_size = sizeof(int);
}

int main() {
    ipc_server_handle_t svr = ipc_server_create("calc_service", 4);
    ipc_server_register_binary_reply(svr, "add", AddHandler, nullptr);
    while(1) sleep(1);
}
```

### Python client
```python
from lingofuse import C4
client = C4("CalcService", "ipc:calc_service")
result = client.add(10, 20)  # 30, latency < 1ms
```

### Go client
```go
client, _ := lingofuse.NewClient()
client.PrepareClient("ipc:calc_service")
result, _ := client.Call("CalcService", param, 3000)
```

### Build
```bash
mkdir build && cd build
cmake .. -DZIPC_BUILD_SHARED=ON -DZIPC_ENABLE_LOGGING=OFF
make -j$(nproc)
```

## When to use zIPC
- Same-machine, multi-language process communication
- AI inference services with Python/C++/Go components
- Game servers with mixed C++/C#/Python services
- Industrial automation / PLC upper-computer communication
- Microservice sidecars
- Plugin systems where plugins may be written in different languages

## Relation to LingoFuse
zIPC is the same-machine IPC engine under LingoFuse. Use zIPC directly if you only need same-machine IPC. Use LingoFuse if you need cross-language RPC, service discovery, load balancing, and agent communication.
